trust_decision.summary: Which browser origins may read App server responses: decided once by the global Starlette CORSMiddleware (allow_origins=['*']) and again, independently, by the /media handler's hard-coded Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * response header.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'wildcard CORS'; the only CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=['*'] is in the server app factory.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP route of the App server (routes tuple, /graphql, /plugins and / static mounts)

fix_sites.module_kind: route handler, response headers set directly (bypasses middleware decision)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: After tightening CORSMiddleware the solver can argue /media is 'media serving that must stay embeddable cross-origin (3D loaders, workers, notebook proxies)' and that the middleware already governs it, while a simple GET needs no preflight so the handler's own '*' still lets any site read arbitrary local files.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate cross-origin use: the dev App (vite dev server) calls the API at VITE_API=http://localhost:5151 from a different port, plugins load scripts from VITE_API, and fetch uses mode 'cors'; notebook/Colab/Databricks contexts reach the server via proxy_url. Also /media must keep exposing Accept-Ranges/Content-Range/Content-Length for range reads. An over-broad fix (drop all CORS / reject all Origins) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: unknown: fix diff is empty; plausible variants are absent Origin, same-origin, localhost/127.0.0.1 on other ports, null origin, arbitrary external origin, preflight OPTIONS vs simple GET/HEAD

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Screenshot response that sets its own permissive Access-Control-Allow-Origin header like /media does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Screenshots are rendered into Databricks/notebook HTML through a proxy origin (screenshot.py:33-39), so a maintainer could add a wildcard header to make them load cross-origin.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HeadersMiddleware echoing the request Origin into Access-Control-Allow-Origin in notebook contexts
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That middleware already special-cases notebook/iframe contexts for COOP/COEP; a notebook-compat CORS tweak would sit there naturally.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Static (plugins/static mount) file_response adding its own ACAO: * for plugin bundles
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugin JS is loaded cross-origin in dev via VITE_API (app/packages/plugins/src/index.ts:96-97).

O9_family: CORS misconfiguration / origin validation (CWE-346, CWE-942): permissive cross-origin read of a localhost server

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace allow_origins=['*'] in app.py with a localhost allow-list and stop, leaving /media's own hard-coded Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * in place.

out_of_scope_notes: No Host-header / DNS-rebinding check on the App server; separate concern from CORS origin policy.
